recipe.visualDefinition: A four-quadrant grid composition featuring mirrored and inverted close-up portraits and textural details. The aesthetic utilizes a high-contrast duotone palette of deep indigo and muted teal, punctuated by smaller inset rectangular frames containing high-detail textures or secondary portraits.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal symmetry between the macro eye portraits in top-left and bottom-right quadrants.
Contrast between organic facial features and the metallic, repetitive texture of heavy chains.
Horizontal typographic axis cutting across the center of the grid.
Layered inset frames breaking the primary grid boundaries.
coreInvariants: Duotone color mapping (shadows to deep blue, highlights to pale cyan/teal)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Macro portraits occupy the top-left and bottom-right corners; textural jewelry shots occupy the top-right and bottom-left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The horizontal text line spanning the middle of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the top-left gaze, across the central text, down to the bottom-right gaze, then circle through the inset detail frames.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with high-contrast visual information.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with low overall color saturation, creating a metallic, cold atmosphere.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thick and thin lines
Large x-height for the secondary text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Overlapping characters in the subtitle line
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A large, wide display serif paired with a smaller, tightly tracked version of a similar serif for textural contrast.

preserve: Horizontal stretch of the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the wide, sharp serif feel

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a 2x2 grid. Top-left and bottom-right: extreme macro close-up of a face with an eye patch, high contrast, indigo duotone. Top-right and bottom-left: macro shot of heavy silver chains, teal duotone. Add two small vertical rectangular insets near the center containing high-contrast textures in a magenta-tinted duotone.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a large, horizontally stretched white serif title across the center horizontal axis. Below it, place a smaller subtitle in lowercase letters with very tight tracking so the letters nearly touch, using a muted teal color.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette limited to indigo and teal duotones?
Is the main title horizontally expanded?
Are there small rectangular insets breaking the main grid?

adjustableVariables: Horizontal stretch factor of the typography
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Any recognizable brand logos on jewelry
postGenerationChecks: Check for duotone consistency across quadrants
Verify grain is uniform across the entire composition
Confirm the inset frames have distinct color shifts
recipe.reuseFormula: Grid-based duotone macro-portraiture with horizontally-scaled high-contrast serif typography.
